pkgmetadata.longdescription: QindaQt Office is the office suite for the QindaQt desktop: QindaWrite (word processor), QindaCalc (spreadsheet), QindaShow (presentations) and QindaNote (notes with pen input). Every document lives in an ordinary top-level window so the desktop's window containers provide tab and split grouping, and each window exports its menu to the panel over the desktop's D-Bus dbusmenu stack. AI assistance runs through the user's Claude/Codex/Kimi CLI subscriptions or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP endpoints.

use.flag: Enable headless LibreOffice conversion for docx/xls/ppt-class import and export (default on)
